# PerfAtlas

> The modern directory for JMeter plugins — search, discover, compare, and track the velocity of load testing extensions, with AI-ready plugin highlights. Data synced nightly from canonical JMeter plugin repositories.

PerfAtlas (https://plugins.jmeter.ai) is a high-performance static site built with Astro that aggregates JMeter plugin data, tracks daily and weekly download trends, and curates collections of plugins for common load testing scenarios. It is maintained by NaveenKumar Namachivayam (QAInsights).

## What PerfAtlas Does

PerfAtlas is a free, community-driven directory of Apache JMeter plugins. It indexes 100+ plugins sourced from the official JMeter Plugins registry (https://jmeter-plugins.org), provides real-time download statistics, and surfaces trending plugins by weekly delta. Data is refreshed nightly via GitHub Actions. The site does not sell plugins — all listed plugins are free and open source.

## Who Maintains This

PerfAtlas is built and maintained by NaveenKumar Namachivayam, a performance engineering consultant and author at QAInsights (https://qainsights.com). His expertise covers Apache JMeter, Gatling, k6, and AI-assisted performance testing. He can be found on Twitter/X at @qainsights and GitHub at github.com/QAInsights.

## Core Features

- Plugin directory with full-text search and tag filtering — search by name, description, or vendor
- Side-by-side plugin comparison — compare up to 4 plugins across downloads, AI-readiness, license, GitHub stars, and category
- Weekly download heatmap and historical usage charts — 52-week trend visualization per plugin
- AI-Ready plugin badge — marks plugins validated for AI-assisted workflows (e.g., usable with AI agents, have predictable APIs, well-documented)
- One-click install command generation for JMeter Plugin Manager — generates the exact command to paste in JMeter's plugin manager
- Favorites system — localStorage-persisted favorites with shareable URL
- Curated Collections: CI/CD Stack, Observability Stack, Load Shaping Stack, AI-Ready Starter
- Vendor pages listing plugins by author/organization
- Blog with JMeter plugin guides and tutorials
- RSS feed at https://plugins.jmeter.ai/rss.xml

## Pages

- [Home](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/): Plugin directory, search, compare, statistics, AI-ready section, and one-click install.
- [Plugin Detail](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/plugin/{plugin-id}/): Individual plugin page with downloads, trend chart, weekly heatmap, component classes, changelog, and related plugins. Replace {plugin-id} with a valid plugin ID such as `jpgc-perfmon`.
- [Compare](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/compare/): Side-by-side comparison table. Add ?ids=jpgc-perfmon,jpgc-casutg to pre-select plugins.
- [Vendors](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/vendor/): Browse plugins grouped by vendor/organization.
- [Collections](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/): Curated plugin stacks for specific testing scenarios.
- [Blog](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/blog/): Tutorials and guides for JMeter plugins and load testing.
- [Settings](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/settings/): Protected user account settings page (requires authentication via Clerk).
- [RSS Feed](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/rss.xml): Blog RSS feed.
- [Sitemap](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/sitemap-index.xml): Full site sitemap.

## Collections

- [CI/CD Stack](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/ci-cd-stack/): jpgc-plancheck, jpgc-autostop, jpgc-synthesis — headless-friendly plugins for CI pipelines.
- [Observability Stack](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/observability-stack/): jpgc-perfmon, jmeter-datadog-backend-listener, elasticsearch listener — real-time metrics streaming to Datadog, Elasticsearch, and more.
- [Load Shaping Stack](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/load-shaping-stack/): jpgc-casutg, jpgc-tst, jpgc-autostop — precise RPS schedules and concurrency-based thread groups.
- [AI-Ready Starter](https://plugins.jmeter.ai/collections/ai-ready-starter/): All plugins with the AI-Ready badge, auto-populated from the registry.

## Most Downloaded Plugins (Top 5 by absolute downloads, as of 2026)

1. Custom Thread Groups (jpgc-casutg) — 1,850,000+ total downloads. Adds Stepping, Ultimate, Concurrency, and Arrivals Thread Groups for realistic traffic modeling.
2. PerfMon Server Performance Monitoring (jpgc-perfmon) — 1,400,000+ downloads. Streams CPU, memory, and network metrics from target servers in real time during load tests.
3. 5 Additional Graphs (jpgc-graphs-basic) — 1,350,000+ downloads. Renders Response Codes, Bytes Throughput, Connect Times, Latency, and Hits/s charts in GUI mode.
4. Dummy Sampler (jpgc-dummy) — 1,200,000+ downloads. Generates synthetic results for script debugging with 0ms processing time.
5. Throughput Shaping Timer (jpgc-tst) — 1,150,000+ downloads. Controls exact requests-per-second (RPS) schedules with less than 1% variance.

## Data & Integrations

- Plugin data fetched from the official JMeter Plugins registry via `scripts/fetchData.mjs`
- GitHub Actions workflow syncs data nightly
- AI-Ready flags and custom metadata managed in `src/data/overrides.json`
- Collections defined in `src/data/collections.json`

## Pricing

PerfAtlas is free to use. All plugins listed in the directory are free and open source. There are no paid tiers, no API keys required for browsing, and no paywalled content. The site is supported by the community.
